### what_to_do_first.details[1]
Sentence: Because the Health Care Act sets no legal maximum time for a cancer suspicion and uniform diagnostic timetables are lacking, the team recommends reporting access times using THL Ohjaus 21/2016 definitions for 16 cancers and flagging stalled handovers, while the Filha programme's diagnostics recommendation with recommended time limits is to be carried out before the 2030 mid-term evaluation.
